findings.title: spawn_node coordinates silently truncate i64 to i32 — negatives and out-of-range values accepted, no fail-loud range check
findings.detail: parse_int returns i64; the i32(x) cast wraps out-of-i32-range values silently (3000000000 -> bogus position) and negatives parse fine. The PR's own stated stance is fail-loud ('The type name resolves against the catalog at lower time (fail loud...)'); coords are the exception. A wrapped position is deterministic, so the golden gate cannot catch it — a nonsense topology gets first-blessed.
findings.recommended_fix: Range-check both coords before the cast (reject |v| > max_i32 and negatives) with a 'bad spawn_node position' parse error, matching the fail-loud discipline; add one bad-coord demo/unit test.

findings.title: parse_demo error returns leak cloned spawn_node type_name strings + dynamic backings (the documented free pairing only runs on success)
findings.detail: Any parse error after a successful spawn_node line returns {} and discards d, leaking cloned strings (strings.clone, default allocator) and the dynamic arrays. run_demo's defer + demo_replay_destroy only run on the success path. One-shot, bounded CLI fatal path — note severity.
findings.recommended_fix: Free d.nodes' clones before each error return in parse_demo (or parse into a caller-owned arena).

findings.title: fixture off + spawn referencing node ids outside the spawn_node set: packets silently inert, demo still blesses green
findings.detail: flow_seed_demand validates nothing; a spawn from a nonexistent id creates a packet at a dead node (at_node = req.src) that never moves — deterministic, invisible, and the run blesses it. Core behavior is pre-existing; `fixture off` newly exposes it (arbitrary numbering). Authoring error surfaces only as a wrong-looking golden.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate spawn src/dst against the topology's live node ids at lower time (fail loud), or at least note it in the harness report.

findings.title: T2 mismatch/corrupt/no-golden branches + save_diff_bundle (the PR's own allocator + JSON fixes) have zero automated exercise
findings.evidence: append(fails, fmt.aprintf("T2 %dms: golden corrupt or wrong size — cannot compare (re-bless deliberately)", ms))
findings.detail: The three failure branches of check_golden (no-golden, corrupt/wrong-size, pixel mismatch) and the diff-bundle writer are never exercised by any demo/drift/test. The minion's own comment admits this path 'was latent until the first real T2 miss' — the exact bug class this PR fixed (tprintf temp-arena + brace escaping) has no regression pin. Perkins live-probe confirmed the no-golden branch fails correctly at f90351da; the mismatch branch is untested.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a negative harness test that tampers a blessed golden (corrupt + flip pixels + delete) and asserts run fails with the right message.

findings.title: New directive error paths (bad spawn_node/fixture lines, unknown node type, run-setup-failed in replay) exercised by nothing
findings.evidence:
if e := demo_apply_setup(&state, &cfg, cat); e != "" {
			append(fails, fmt.tprintf("replay: run-setup failed: %s", e))
findings.detail: None of the new fail-loud parse/apply paths are covered by a demo, drift mutation, or unit test: bad spawn_node arity/position, bad fixture value, unknown node type, replay-side run-setup failure. All are deterministic authoring errors — cheap to pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a tiny negative-driver mode or a unit test feeding malformed demo text to parse_demo + demo_apply_setup, asserting the one-line errors.

findings.title: Fixture-on + spawn_node combined numbering ('fixture ids 0..2, entries follow at 3..') unexercised at the harness level
findings.detail: ecmp.dem is fixture-off-only; the documented mixed numbering (fixture 0..2 then spawn_node 3..) is deterministic by construction (monotonic next_node_id) but has no live demo or test. A numbering regression would surface only in a future demo.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: one small fixture-on + spawn_node demo (or a topology unit test) pinning ids 0..2 fixture + 3.. spawned.
